scope: 站内当前日报及实际专题路由消费的 PR 材料；离线重建，不抓取 GitHub，不改变首页统计。

globs.selection: all direct JSON editions loaded by import.meta.glob, including reachable archives

topicSources.boundary: TopicPages filters kv-cache out of archiveTopics; ACL legacy report and speculative-decoding initial report remain reachable. Paper/documentation references never become PR identities.
Only the current imported report; legacyArchive paths do not expand the corpus.
filterResearch/ communityEntries admit included PRs; excluded and pending review records and papers are excluded.
communityEntries is the included kv-research PRs plus admitted newEntries. search.candidates is a raw search receipt, never a material library.
Source documentation blob/tree URLs and papers are retained only inside original source records, never counted as PRs.
Same resolution as KvTopicOverview.References; unresolved IDs, paper slugs, and issue/proposal sources do not add PRs.

include: groups.engineeringIds resolved through included communityEntries and group topic
topicSources.boundary: Matches KvResearchOverview engineering selection; paper comparison rows do not add PR identities.
Paper and proposal sources stay separate; a code recheck URL is attached to its declared workId rather than treated as a PR URL.

exclusions: Non-current daily versions, fixtures, synthetic/legacy public/data samples, and arbitrary repository JSON are not scanned.
public/word-reports/topics.json topics[id=kv-cache] is superseded by KvCacheTopic.
kv-research entries with decision=excluded/pending, and all paper entries.
kv-community.search.candidates and search receipts are not collected material.
ACL legacyArchive artifact paths and unimported topic drafts are not followed.
GitHub issues, blobs, trees, commits, release links and papers cannot be normalized to PR identities.
